items.q: Do you disclose that content is AI-generated?
items.a: Yes. We label synthetic content per platform policy and applicable regulation. Every dedicated AI influencer profile carries a clear 'AI' disclosure, and we advise clients on captions and platform-specific tags. See our AI Content & Disclosure page.

items.q: How do you keep a character consistent across posts?
items.a: Each recurring character is defined by a locked reference set and prompt system, so the same face, styling, and vibe carry across every asset and format.

items.q: What about likeness rights for AI influencers?
items.a: AI personas are original and do not depict real people without a signed likeness license. Our internal influencer library blocks any persona with a missing or expired license from being assigned.

items.q: Which languages and dialects do you cover?
items.a: Native Arabic (MSA and major dialects) and English, produced together — not translated as an afterthought.

items.q: Can I white-label this for my agency?
items.a: Yes. The Custom tier includes reseller terms, multi-brand pipelines, and delivery under your brand.
Phase 1 is static imagery and carousels. Video is on the roadmap; the catalog and pricing are built to add it without a rebuild.
